users.title: User Profile
users.description: User account information and profile metadata.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was created

healthNotes.description: User's optional notes about their health

chats.title: Consultation Chat
chats.description: A saved health consultation session between the user and the AI Health Assistant.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this chat session

title.description: The title or summarized topic of the chat

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this session was created

messages.description: The list of chat messages exchanged in the session

symptomChecks.title: Symptom Check
symptomChecks.description: A history of a symptom check run by the user.

userId.description: UID of the user who performed this symptom check

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the check was done

symptoms.description: List of symptoms selected by the user

conditions.description: List of possible conditions returned by the symptom checker

/users/{userId}.description: Collection storing personalized profile metadata for users.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Collection storing historical health consultation chats between users and HealthSphere AI.

/symptomChecks/{checkId}.description: Collection storing historical symptom checking results for users.
